title: Reporter CRISPR screens decipher cis-regulatory and trans-regulatory principles at the Xist locus
model: Female mouse ES cells with a GFP reporter driven by the Xist promoter-proximal element RE57M; CRISPRi of transcription-factor promoters
contrast: GFP-low vs GFP-high sort, paired by replicate (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: ZIC3 and OCT4 (Pou5f1) activate promoter-proximal Xist elements
barcs_calls: 95 promoters at FDR 0.10 after control calibration
verdict: BARCS recovers both activators the paper names for this reporter, Pou5f1 (#3) and Zic3 (#5), behind the reporter's own positive controls. Non-targeting guides were inflated (15% at p < 0.05), so the hit list was calibrated to them.
